About the organization of the Women's Christian Temperance Union at Savoy College reported in Y.M.C.A. Convention Reports, Mrs. Lee Lindsey De Jarnet writes:

About that time, I recall, my dear mother and many other good women were using their influence to organize the W.C.T.U. in this community. Miss Pamela Paxton of the W.C.T.U. The first organizer of the Order of Good Templars. It is Pamela Paxton who carries in the writing an account of the following episode which as well reflects "negativism," as a chore. "I recall that many of the young temperance ladies would sign the pledge to bring some of the young men around."
